kpss.p_value_ceiling_note: p-value capped at 0.10 by statsmodels table

stationarity_tests.d_recommendation_note: EDA heuristic recommendation only. NOT a mandatory modeling requirement. Final differencing order decided in 02_feature_engineering and 03_modeling.

exploratory_sarima_heuristic.status: EDA-suggested baseline heuristic (NOT optimal model search)
exploratory_sarima_heuristic.methodology_note: This p/q rule is a project-specific EDA heuristic based on the count of significant ACF/PACF lags. It is not a formal Box-Jenkins order identification procedure and must not be interpreted as an optimal order.

derivation_rule.d: 0 if STATIONARY; 1 if NON-STATIONARY; null if INCONCLUSIVE
derivation_rule.D: 1 (seasonal differencing heuristic for feasible seasonal candidate)

exploratory_sarima_heuristic.seasonal_template_note: candidate_seasonal_orders are seasonal templates (P=1, D=1, Q=1, s). When d_recommendation is null, they are NOT executable full SARIMA orders because the non-seasonal differencing order d remains undetermined. Downstream modeling (02_feature_engineering and 03_modeling) must select d.

ljung_box.portmanteau_note: Ljung-Box at lag L is a portmanteau test for cumulative autocorrelation up to L; not a test for seasonality at period L.

eda_implication: MSTL with periods=(7,30,365) does not fully capture all short-term structure in residuals.
Residual autocorrelation (if present) suggests AR/lag representations merit downstream evaluation.
Non-Gaussian residuals (if present) suggest conditional distribution modeling merits downstream evaluation.
Neither result establishes superiority of any specific model family.

backward_compatibility_disclaimer: The top-level fields 'suggested_sarima_order' and 'suggested_seasonal_order' are backward-compatibility aliases provided solely for legacy consumers (such as EDAReport and 01.7 synthesis). When d_recommendation is null (INCONCLUSIVE), 'suggested_sarima_order' falls back to d=0 solely to maintain Tuple[int, int, int] schema validity for SARIMA_EDA initialization. This does NOT represent a finding of stationarity or a recommendation of d=0. Downstream modeling MUST consume 'stationarity_tests.combined_conclusion' and 'stationarity_tests.d_recommendation' instead of this legacy alias.
